BiblicalUsage: To mock appears once, and it is the last straw before the exile in 2 Chronicles 36:16: the people "mocked the messengers of God, and despised his words, and misused his prophets, until the wrath of the LORD arose against his people, till there was no remedy."
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the verse is the saddest in the history: they did not only refuse the word, they mocked the men who brought it, and when there was no remedy left, the judgment came.
